verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no published usage pricing for MoQ Relay, neither per participant-minute nor per unit of bandwidth. It only describes open-source and self-hostable components, plus a free public test relay. Pricing is a fair axis for a media relay/CDN product that could offer a hosted tier, so the lack of evidence makes this 'none' rather than 'na'.

support.subject: As a founder, usage pricing is published per participant-minute or per unit of bandwidth, so I can model cost without talking to sales
